measurement.method: Rendered-pixel paired capture: original, transparent text background, black/white calibration. Glyph coverage inferred from black/white delta and ancestor opacity; full-coverage rendered foreground reconstructed from original/background. Worst sampled pixel ratio per text range; ±0.03 rounding tolerance. All screenshots memory-only. Gradients sampled rather than excluded.
